ingress.label: Ingress
ingress.doing: Preparing the chat turn for RuntimeKernel.
ingress.expected_output: Runtime state contains the latest user input.

knowledge_retrieve.label: Knowledge Retrieve
knowledge_retrieve.expected_output: Relevant knowledge candidates are available to later nodes.

precheck.label: Precheck
precheck.purpose: Apply lightweight policy checks before answering.
precheck.doing: Evaluating whether the request may proceed.
precheck.expected_output: The turn is either allowed, blocked, or sent to approval.

approval_gate.label: Approval Gate
approval_gate.purpose: Pause for human approval when policy requires it.
approval_gate.expected_output: The approved request continues to the answer node.

answer.label: Answer
answer.purpose: Generate the assistant response or request tool calls.
answer.doing: Calling the configured task model with current context and tools.
answer.expected_output: Assistant text or native tool calls.

tool_exec.label: Tool Execution
tool_exec.purpose: Execute model-requested tools through the unified gateway.
tool_exec.expected_output: Tool observation messages are returned to the model.

postcheck.label: Postcheck
postcheck.purpose: Apply final policy checks before committing the response.
postcheck.expected_output: The response is allowed or blocked.
